create_lru_cache_policy: create an LRU cache policy instance with a given cache capacity for KV block offloading
insert_lru_cache_block: insert a KV block with its key and block status into the LRU cache policy
touch_lru_cache_keys: touch a set of keys in the LRU cache to move them to the most-recently-used end
evict_lru_cache_blocks: evict n KV blocks from the LRU cache that have zero reference count and are not protected
remove_lru_cache_block: remove a KV block from the LRU cache by its key
